## Why this replaces the re-cut
Nothing in her existing footage shows a kid slouching without burned-in text, so no rule-following cut can be made from old posts. Wednesday becomes the second slouch-to-lift of the week, framed as a how-to so it also gets found by search ("how to set up an iPad for kids").

## Hook (frame one)
- **Title (stays):** `how to set up your kid's iPad so they stop slouching`
- **Visual:** daughter hunched over the iPad on her lap, side-on, same framing as Monday (shoot both in one sitting, different top)
- **Spoken (shot 2 onward):** "Three things, thirty seconds."

## Script
```
Three things, thirty seconds.
One: the iPad never lives flat in the lap. Flat means head down.
Two: screen up to the eyes. A case with a stand built in does it for you. This one's DigiRoo.
Three: a twenty-minute timer, and when it goes off, she stands up.
Save this for the next iPad session. What's your rule? 👇
```
